title: Made a Roguelike Mobile RPG Have 5 Players lol
author: dandreabrian
selftext:
Hey guys put about 600+ hours into this project and updating daily,

I have about 5 players so far the game is still in beta on android/iphone.

I have a discord and if interested in playing there are PLENTY of spots open to beta test.

comments.author: Low_Imagination_9670
comments.body:
I'm building an AI game platform, one that allows players to join from any device, like for example, use their phones as controllers and play on a shared TV, or 4x ppl joining remotely from their laptops, etc

[pwned.games](http://pwned.games)

Would this interest you?

You can choose to sell it to a host that can bring other co-op players for free, or everyone needs to buy the game, or let it be free, or free if they own a pass and you get a share of the revenue from pass sales.
